title: Feature Inkling Logbook
content:
Morning dump — quick capture before standup. Goal: tighten PRD scope for token-cost telemetry and lightweight canary rollout. Keep this file as the single-source scratch during editing; will move to PRD branch when cleaned.

Top priorities today:
- Narrow acceptance criteria for cost regressions (0.5% unit-cost overhead commit threshold) — confirm with eng SLO team.
- Remove feature flag toggle complexity: prefer single toggle + routing policy instead of multiple flags.
- Draft quick email to Solutions Engs about canary window and rollback plan (below).

PRD edits to make:
- Intro: add 2-sentence product intent (who, pain).
- Metrics: add per-route token histogram + 95th latency target for small bursts. Need sample charts from observability (ask Mallory).
- Rollout: enumerate staged audience (internal -> beta customers -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%), with auto-fallback to v-small model variant.
- Dependencies: call out require update to routing API (feature: prefer-latency-or-cost param).

Stakeholder follow-ups (quick):
- @Evan: confirm infra cost calc assumptions by EOD.
- @Priya: copy for external-facing launch note; quick 3 bullets.
- Security review: ping S&C for KMS integration checklist (ticket JIRA-SEC-199).

Launch checklist (working):
- [ ] Canary plan doc (confluence) — create and link.
- [ ] Canary smoke scripts (SRE) — need 2 scripts: small prompt mix + long-context stress.
- [ ] Rollback policy reviewed + signed by eng and support.
- [ ] Eval prompt set added for quality regression alerts.
- [ ] Cost dashboard tile for feature (token delta, avg tokens/request).

Notes to self / rough phrasing for email to SEs: 
Subject: Quick heads-up — rolling out token telemetry and cost-aware routing (canary window).
Body bullets (short):
- We’re launching token-level telemetry and a routing knob that lets us prefer low-cost variants under load.
- Canary schedule: internal -> small beta group (Mar 12-14) -> 10% (Mar 15) -> step to 50% if metrics ok.
- If you manage customers in beta group, dm me a list today.

Open questions / blockers:
- Do we have exact 95th-latency SLOs by model size? (ask SRE team).
- Need an owner for the canary smoke scripts (possible: SRE on call?)
- Is the billing delta per-token surfaced in the console for customers? (if not, adjust communications).

Evening tasks (if time):
- Clean up PRD section 3.2 and add example API snippet.
- Finalize email copy for Solutions Engs.

Random brain: maybe add opt-out clause for enterprise tenants via policy routing (customer-configurable). Good hinge for Private customers.

---
Tiny notes: copied a snippet from meeting with Mallory about histograms — paste into PRD later.
